QCR HOLDINGS INC Q2 2026: Revenue $97.3M, EPS $2.19— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
QCR HOLDINGS INC reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $97.3M and net income of $36.3M, driven by higher net interest income and stronger capital markets and wealth management fees versus the year-ago quarter.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue was $97.3M for Q2 2026, compared with $84.2M in Q2 2025; YoY change 15.6%.
  • Net income was $36.3M for Q2 2026, compared with $29.0M in Q2 2025; YoY change 25.0%.
  • Diluted EPS was $2.19 for Q2 2026, compared with $1.71 in Q2 2025; YoY change 28.1%.

Business Highlights

  • Revenue growth and profitability: Net income and adjusted diluted EPS rose notably year over year, supported by higher net interest income and increased capital markets fees.
  • Capital markets shift: Capital markets revenue, including swap fees and LIHTC-related income, increased about 69% YoY and has become a more meaningful recurring fee source.
  • Wealth management momentum: Assets under management grew 9% sequentially, lifting trust and advisory fees and expanding client relationships.
  • Loan growth and origination mix: Core loan growth remained strong (approximately 12% annualized excluding securitizations) with emphasis on LIHTC and commercial real estate lending.
  • Operational efficiency and digital: The efficiency ratio improved roughly 310 basis points sequentially while the company continued investments in digital transformation, which increased occupancy and equipment costs.

Original SEC Filing: QCR HOLDINGS INC [ QCRH ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026

data.title: JOHNSON OUTDOORS INC 3Q FY2026: Revenue $189.7M, EPS $1.42— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Johnson Outdoors Inc reported third-quarter fiscal 2026 results with revenue of $189.7M and diluted EPS of $1.42, driven by strength in its Fishing and Diving businesses and improved margins following tariff refunds; net income rose to $14.95M for the quarter.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue was $189.7M, compared with $180.7M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 5%.
  • Net income was $14.95M, compared with $7.74M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 93.2%.
  • Diluted EPS was $1.42, compared with $0.75 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 89.3%.

Business Highlights

  • Consolidated net sales rose 5% in the quarter and 15% year-to-date, led by strong performance in the Fishing segment and pricing actions.
  • Fishing and Diving brands showed strong product response, with new products and market positioning driving double-digit growth in those areas.
  • Improved trade conditions and favorable foreign exchange (notably in Diving by roughly 2–3%) supported international sales gains.
  • The company received approximately $15.6M in IEEPA tariff refunds, which boosted gross margins and quarterly operating income.
  • Management noted a strategic buildup of inventory and safety stock to support higher volumes amid raw material cost pressures.

Original SEC Filing: JOHNSON OUTDOORS INC [ JOUT ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026

data.title: HANMI Financial Corp Q2 2026: Revenue $72.2M, Net income $23.51M, EPS $0.79— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
HANMI Financial Corp reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $72.2M and net income of $23.51M, reflecting year‑over‑year gains driven by higher net interest income and loan growth alongside reduced credit losses.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue was $72.2M for Q2 2026, up from $65.2M in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change 10.7%.
  • Net income was $23.505M for Q2 2026, compared with $15.117M in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change 55.5%.
  • Diluted EPS was $0.79 for Q2 2026, versus $0.50 in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change 58.0%.

Business Highlights

  • Revenue momentum: Net interest income rose, contributing to an 11.8% sequential increase (3‑month) and 13.2% year‑to‑date growth, supported by lower liability rates and loan growth.
  • Loan portfolio shift: Growth in commercial and industrial lending increased interest‑earning assets; loan production totaled $749.8M year‑to‑date.
  • Deposit and funding dynamics: Deposits increased 4.2% year‑to‑date with growth in time deposits and noninterest demand deposits, allowing the bank to reduce borrowings.
  • Credit and asset quality: Credit loss expense and net charge‑offs declined materially versus the prior year; nonperforming loans decreased and reserves remained stable.
  • Operational efficiency: Higher revenue was partially offset by rising operating costs — including data processing, professional fees, and wages — reflecting investments in technology and staffing.

Original SEC Filing: HANMI FINANCIAL CORP [ HAFC ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026

data.title: FIRST MID BANCSHARES, INC. Q2 2026: Revenue $114.9M, EPS $1.04— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
FIRST MID BANCSHARES, INC. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue and earnings up year over year, driven by higher interest income and growth in non‑interest revenue following acquisitions and organic expansion.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue: Total interest income of $114.9M for Q2 2026 vs $93.4M in Q2 2025 (23.0% YoY).
  • Net income: $27.8M for Q2 2026 vs $23.4M in Q2 2025 (18.6% YoY).
  • Diluted EPS: $1.04 for Q2 2026 vs $0.98 in Q2 2025 (6.1% YoY).

Business Highlights

  • YTD net income rose to $54.1M in 2026, supported by higher net interest income and expanded non‑interest income.
  • Wealth management, insurance commissions and fee income increased following acquisitions and organic growth.
  • Acquisition of Two Rivers Bank expanded the company’s footprint, loan and deposit base, and trust/brokerage capabilities.
  • Staffing increased to 1,316 full‑time equivalents from 1,190, with integration expenses reflecting branch and service expansion.
  • Loan portfolio growth continued with active credit monitoring amid higher nonperforming loans and increased repossessed assets.

data.title: BREAKING NEWS: ELEKTROS Strengthens Its Position Across Lithium and EV Innovation as Its Sierra Leone Strategy and U.S. Charging Patent Gain Visibility
data.description:
ELEKTROS Highlights Continued Momentum Behind Its Hard-Rock Lithium Program and Proprietary EV Charging Patent as It Pursues Long-Term Strategic Growth

ELEKTROS Inc. - Publicly Traded (Ticker Symbol: ELEK)

As Wall Street continues to demonstrate powerful momentum near historic highs, echoing the excitement of the dot-com era, record equity markets and accelerating battery-material demand are shining a brighter spotlight on companies participating in the electrification economy. ELEKTROS Inc. reiterated that it remains deeply committed to advancing its hard-rock lithium initiatives, defending its patented EV charging technology and exploring strategic business opportunities that may enhance long-term shareholder value.

WEST PALM BEACH, FL / ACCESS Newswire / August 7, 2026 / Against a backdrop of U.S. equity markets trading near historic record levels, investor interest in electrification, critical minerals, advanced energy technologies and emerging growth companies remains substantial. ELEKTROS Inc. (Ticker:ELEK) today reiterated its continued focus on advancing its hard-rock lithium mining initiatives, electric vehicle charging patent strategy and broader long-term strategic growth objectives.

The Company remains confident that this summer's vibrant market environment has fostered renewed enthusiasm across many areas of the public markets, including microcap and penny-stock companies positioned around next-generation industries. ELEKTROS remains confident that expanding recognition of its rare-earth and critical-minerals vision, its Sierra Leone hard-rock lithium initiatives and its advanced EV charging intellectual property is helping bring the Company before a broader audience of retail, microcap and institutional investors worldwide.

Management remains confident that the worldwide evolution toward electric mobility, battery storage and next-generation charging infrastructure continues to generate compelling long-term opportunities across the lithium and EV ecosystem. The Company further remains confident that attractive market entry points can encourage investors to study emerging companies at an early stage; however, ELEKTROS emphasizes that all investment decisions should be made only after careful, independent due diligence and consideration of each investor's individual financial circumstances and risk tolerance.

Recent reporting from the Financial Times, The Wall Street Journal and China Daily has drawn attention to the growing importance of lithium supply chains, battery materials, refining capacity and EV infrastructure as global demand continues its expansion.

ELEKTROS continues advancing hard-rock lithium opportunities in Sierra Leone while also progressing United States Patent No. 12,522,100 B1, which relates to advanced electric vehicle charging technology designed to improve charging efficiency and reduce charging times.

Elon Musk has previously stated: "It is definitely true that the fundamental enabling technology for electric cars is lithium-ion as a cell chemistry technology. In the absence of that, I don't think it's possible to make an electric car that is competitive with a gasoline car."

The Company also continues exploring strategic opportunities connected to its patent portfolio, including potential licensing discussions and other strategic alternatives, while preserving its strong commitment to protecting its intellectual property.

"We believe today's valuation offers investors an opportunity worth careful consideration. In our opinion, purchasing shares at a bottom-basement discount can resemble owning options that never expire, allowing shareholders to participate in our future vision for as long as they choose to remain invested. That is our belief-not a guarantee-and we invite penny-stock enthusiasts, microcap investors and institutions alike to evaluate ELEKTROS independently." - Shlomo Bleier, CEO

"Management believes that purchasing ELEKTROS equity at what we believe is a bottom-basement valuation is like owning options that never expire. In our opinion, today's entry point provides long-term investors the opportunity to participate in our vision for as long as they choose to remain shareholders. This reflects management's belief and is not a guarantee of future performance." - Management
